meta.name: workshop-facilitation
meta.description: Facilitate workshop sessions in a one-step, multi-turn flow. Use when an interactive skill needs consistent pacing, options, and progress tracking.

copy.tagline: 引导工作坊的互动流程，保持节奏与进度
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要主持结构化的团队工作坊或会议
copy.tagline_en: Facilitate workshop sessions with consistent pacing and progress tracking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to host structured team workshops or meetings

howto.what: Claude 会一次只问一个问题，逐步引导你完成工作坊。它会显示进度（如“背景问题 3/8”），在需要做决定时给出编号选项，并支持你粘贴已有信息或让 Claude 猜测缺失内容。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 主持一个结构化工作坊（如产品定位、发现冲刺启动会），或任何需要分步引导、进度追踪的互动场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我主持一个45分钟的回顾会，主题是我们失败的beta发布。
用引导模式运行一个产品定位工作坊。
say.note: Claude 会一步步提问，收集背景信息并给出建议。

howto.what_en: Claude asks one question at a time, shows progress (e.g., 'Context Q3/8'), offers numbered options at decision points, and accepts pasted context or best-guess mode.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to facilitate a structured workshop (e.g., product positioning, discovery sprint kickoff) or any interactive session needing step-by-step guidance and progress tracking.

say_en.text: Facilitate a 45-min retro on our failed beta launch.
say_en.note: Claude will give an estimated time and ask for entry mode.

say_en.text: Run a product positioning workshop in guided mode.
say_en.note: Claude will ask questions one by one and provide recommendations.
